svg.title: About Aon: TNI Information Technology graduate with Second-Class Honors; building web products, learning Go, Rust and Japanese, with JLPT N2 as a long-term goal
svg.text: Hello, I’m Aon — a developer who enjoys turning complex ideas into practical digital products.
B.Sc. Information Technology, Thai-Nichi Institute of Technology. Second-Class Honors.
My work spans frontend interfaces, backend APIs, dashboards and data-rich experiences.
